title: Episode Title: Air Canada's A321XLR Face-Plants on Its Big Debut, Kirby Wants Chicago All to Himself, and Frontier Finds New Ways to Take Your Miles
summary: Air Canada's shiny new narrowbody couldn't hack it on the London route it was built for, Scott Kirby is already measuring the drapes for a United-only O'Hare, and two airline CEOs suddenly want to be mentioned in the same breath as Singapore Airlines. Plus, Frontier's elite program gets the machete treatment, and Spirit's flight attendants are fighting to keep their medical records out of Google's hands.
